args.title: Support rupee and Swiss franc signs in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The parseAmount function should be updated to recognize and correctly process amounts with the rupee sign '₹' and the Swiss franc sign 'CHF'. This involves modifying the regular expression used to strip non-numeric symbols to include these additional currency signs.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseAmount function does not currently handle the rupee sign '₹' or the Swiss franc sign. This causes amounts with these signs to be rejected as non-numeric during import. The function needs updating to support these symbols.
